name: equilibrium geometry and frequencies of triplet phenylnitrene

prompt.query: Determine the equilibrium geometry and harmonic vibrational frequencies of triplet phenylnitrene (the ground state of C6H5N). Species SMILES: [N]c1ccccc1; total charge 0, multiplicity 3; conditions: gas phase. Model the process you investigate as a graph and maintain `mechanism_graph.json` in the sandbox root: nodes for every species or electronic state you characterize (with SMILES) and edges for the state changes or transformations between them (with `via` pointing to the TS node id when a transition state was located). Extra nodes or edges beyond the reference are never penalized, so record every state you actually characterized. Every computational evidence file you produce for a species or step (QM input or log) must carry a `smiles: <SMILES>` comment line identifying the species, so the scorer can bind each graph element to concrete evidence. The scorer reads this file forensically; a missing or unparseable file severely impacts the score. In your final summary you must report the principal geometric parameters (in Angstrom and degrees) and a characterization of the harmonic vibrational frequencies of triplet phenylnitrene. If you conclude that the requested quantity cannot be computed to a trustworthy accuracy with the allowed methods, you must say so explicitly in your final summary and explain the electronic-structure reason; do not report a number you cannot stand behind. Run the computations with ORCA or Gaussian: the scorer parses only these two programs' log formats, so output from any other program cannot count as evidence. Allowed computational methods are limited to xTB; calls beyond the whitelist are intercepted.
